skills.name: Wall Plumb
skills.criteria: Tolerance: 1/8” in 4 ft. Deduct 1 pt per 1/16” deviation. Measure at 3 points.

skills.name: Level
skills.criteria: Tolerance: 1/8” in 4 ft. Deduct 1 pt per 1/16” deviation. Measure at 2 points.

skills.name: Story Height
skills.criteria: Tolerance: 1/8” in 4 ft. Deduct 1 pt per 1/16” deviation. Measure at 1 point.

skills.name: Wall Length
skills.criteria: End-to-end walls: within 3/8”; Adjacent walls: exact. Deduct 1 pt per 1/16” deviation.

skills.name: Voids
skills.criteria: Deduct 1 pt for every void in mortar joints.

skills.name: Time
skills.criteria: Full score if completed in time limit. Deduct 1 pt per minute over.

skills.name: Brick/Block Technique
skills.criteria: Deduct 1 pt per instance: relayed blocks, exposed sashes, smearing, over-tapping, redundant leveling.

skills.name: Safety Practices
skills.criteria: Deduct 1 pt per issue: no PPE, unsafe behavior (e.g., jumping walls), breaking down walls.

skills.name: Overall Appearance
skills.criteria: Deduct 1 pt per: undersized/oversized joints, sloppy tooling, broken/protruding blocks.

skills.name: Distance
skills.criteria: Tolerance: 1/8” in 4 ft. Deduct 1 pt per 1/16” deviation. Measure at 3 points.

skills.name: Mortar Net
skills.criteria: Loose and at the bottom, ridges up. Deduct 5 points if set incorrectly.

skills.name: Ties
skills.criteria: Failed if any tie is not in place.

skills.name: Weep Holes
skills.criteria: Failed if no weep holes, deduct 2 points for each weep hole protruding from brick.

skills.name: Flashing
skills.criteria: Failed if omitted. Deduct 2 points for every 1/4" inconsistency from face of brick.

skills.name: Termination Bar
skills.criteria: Failed if omitted. Deduct 2 point for every screw omitted.

skills.name: Installation Planning
skills.criteria: Deduct 1 pt per instance: relayed flashing, or weep holes.

skills.name: Safety Practices
skills.criteria: Deduct 1 pt per issue: no PPE, unsafe behavior (e.g., jumping walls), breaking down walls.

skills.name: Overall Appearance
skills.criteria: Deduct 1 pt per: undersized/oversized joints, sloppy tooling, broken/protruding blocks.

skills.name: Position
skills.criteria: Tolerance: 1/8” in from center Deduct 1 pt per 1/16” deviation.

skills.name: Elevation
skills.criteria: Tolerance: 1/8” in from Height. Deduct 1 pt per 1/16” deviation.

skills.name: Space for Dry Pack
skills.criteria: Tolerance: 1/8” in. Deduct 1 pt per 1/16” deviation.

skills.name: Pocket Size
skills.criteria: Tolerance ½” from top of plate.  Deduct 1 pt per 1/4” deviation.

skills.name: Legs Around Rebar
skills.criteria: Deduct 2 pts for every failed instance.

skills.name: Space for Grout
skills.criteria: Deduct 2 pts per rebar constriction obstructing flow of grout.

skills.name: Plate Is Movable
skills.criteria: Deduct 2 pts per failed instance.

skills.name: Safety Practices
skills.criteria: Deduct 1 pt per issue: no PPE, unsafe behavior (e.g., dry cutting), breaking down walls.

skills.name: Laps
skills.criteria: Deduct 1 pt per: insufficient lap

skills.name: Holes covered
skills.criteria: Deduct 5 points for every instance

skills.name: Overall Bonding
skills.criteria: If unsuccessful, the entire assessment is failed.

skills.name: Overall Level
skills.criteria: Tolerance: 1/8” in 4 ft. Deduct 1 pt per 1/16” deviation. Measure at 2 points.

skills.name: Story Height
skills.criteria: Corners, Cj, Openings, steps (Deduct 1 point for each missed item)

skills.name: Wall Length
skills.criteria: End-to-end walls: within 3/8”; Adjacent walls: exact. Deduct 1 pt per 1/8” deviation.

skills.name: Special Bonding
skills.criteria: Corners, Cj, Openings, Cuts for steps (Deduct 1 point for each missed item)

skills.name: Time
skills.criteria: Full score if completed in time limit. Deduct 1 pt per minute over.

skills.name: Layout Technique
skills.criteria: Deduct 1 pt per instance: Extra marks or half erased.

skills.name: Safety Practices
skills.criteria: Deduct 1 pt per issue: no PPE, unsafe behavior (e.g., jumping walls), breaking down walls.

skills.name: Overall Appearance
skills.criteria: Deduct 1 pt per: marks not clearly visible, missing marks, falling tape.
